title: Standup notes
audience: For developers who'd rather not reconstruct yesterday from memory at 9:58.
description: One section per working day. Tell your AI what you did and what's next, or let a coding agent draft it from your commits.
tagline: Yesterday, today and what's in the way.
seoTitle: Daily standup template for Claude Code and ChatGPT
note:
Standup notes

Yesterday, today and blockers, one section a day, newest first. Tell your AI what you did, or let a coding agent write yesterday from your commits.

## Blockers
What you're waiting on. It goes from here once it's unblocked.

## Days
One section per working day.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Standup notes". Each morning I'll tell you what I did yesterday and what's next. Read the note with fetch, then add a section at the start of "Days" with edit: a "###" heading with the weekday and today's date, then Yesterday and Today as short bullets. Anything blocked goes under "Blockers"; when I say it's unblocked, remove it.
prompt.claudeCode: Write today's standup into my Pinto Notes note "Standup notes". Run git log --since=yesterday --author="$(git config user.email)" --oneline in this repo, turn the commits into two to five plain-language bullets (no hashes), and ask me what's next and what's blocking me. Then read the note with fetch and add a section at the start of "Days" with edit: a "###" heading with the weekday and today's date, then Yesterday and Today. Anything blocked goes under "Blockers".

asks: Ask what I did yesterday and what's next, then write today's standup.
What was I blocked on last week?
Summarize my standups since Monday for the sprint review.
